create_PixtralVisionConfig: create a PixtralVisionConfig instance with default vision model hyperparameters for Pixtral-12B
initialize_PixtralVisionConfig_custom: initialize a PixtralVisionConfig with custom hidden_size, intermediate_size, and num_hidden_layers values
initialize_PixtralVisionConfig_image_siz: initialize a PixtralVisionConfig with custom image_size and patch_size for the vision encoder
access_PixtralVisionConfig_head_dim: access the computed head_dim attribute derived from hidden_size divided by num_attention_heads
use_PixtralVisionConfig_rope_parameters: configure PixtralVisionConfig with custom rope_parameters for rotary embedding positioning
